\section{Fields of Interest}
Industrial organization; applied microeconomics; competition and regulation;
retail and grocery markets; vertical relationships.

\section{Publications}
\begin{itemize}
  \item ``Exclusionary Contracts and Incentives to Innovate.''
        \textit{Games}, 17(1), 8 (2026).

  \item ``Cross-border Shopping of Alcohol -- What is the Effect on Tax Revenue
        and Sales and Which Products Are Most Affected?'' (with Richard Friberg
        and Frode Steen). \textit{Review of International Economics}, 33(5)
        (2025), pp.~1021--1034.

  \item ``The effect of cross-border shopping on commodity tax revenue: results
        from Norway's COVID-19 border closings'' (with Richard Friberg, Emil
        Halseth and Frode Steen). \textit{Scandinavian Journal of Economics},
        126(4) (2024). \textit{Awarded the SJE prize for the best article
        published in 2024.}

  \item ``Co-location, good, bad or both: How does new entry of discount variety
        store affect local grocery business?'' (with Charlotte B. Evensen and
        Frode Steen). \textit{Journal of the European Economic Association},
        22(4) (2024), pp.~1798--1843.

  \item ``Competition and risk taking in local bank markets: Evidence from the
        business loans segment'' (with Chiara Canta and Øivind Anti Nilsen).
        \textit{Journal of Empirical Finance}, 73 (2023), pp.~153--169.

  \item ``Hump-shaped cross-price effects and the extensive margin in
        cross-border shopping'' (with Richard Friberg and Frode Steen).
        \textit{American Economic Journal: Microeconomics}, 14(2) (2022),
        pp.~408--38.

  \item ``Bank consolidation, interest rates, and risk: A post-merger analysis
        based on loan-level data from the corporate sector'' (with Steffen
        Juranek and Øivind Anti Nilsen). \textit{Journal of Competition Law \&
        Economics}, 18(4) (2022), pp.~771--794.

  \item ``Lump-sum payments and retail services: A relational contracting
        perspective'' (with Teis L. Lømo). \textit{Journal of Industrial
        Economics}, 69 (2021), pp.~131--168.

  \item ``Competing buyers, rent extraction and inefficient exclusion.''
        \textit{International Journal of Industrial Organization}, 68 (2020).

  \item ``Upstream merger in a successive oligopoly: Who pays the price?'' (with
        Øivind Anti Nilsen and Lars Sørgard). \textit{International Journal of
        Industrial Organization}, 48 (2016), pp.~143--172.

  \item ``Interlocking relationships and quantity rationing.''
        \textit{Economics Letters}, 146 (2016), pp.~47--49.

  \item ``Menu contracts and the division of profits in vertical
        relationships.'' \textit{Economics Letters}, 138 (2016), pp.~72--74.
\end{itemize}
